patch_description: The current program stops after λ binary-search packing. Add a local-search refinement phase that takes the packing result and performs move/swap moves accepted when the full sorted KVPR vector improves lexicographically (i.e., compare sorted descending KVPR vectors; accept if `new_sorted < old_sorted`). This full-vector objective balances all GPUs, not just the max, which often lets subsequent moves reduce the true maximum. Guard with a 3000-iteration cap and use incremental load/mem arrays for speed. This directly implements the recommendation to try K=full in the lexicographic top-K objective.
